protocol.primary_population: Original trailing-watermark exits with watermark level exactly one band
protocol.start: First source row after actual original exit ordinal, including later rows with the same timestamp
protocol.end: First original protective-stop touch/cross or 15:45 NY, whichever occurs first; targets are measured independently
protocol.thresholds: Original frozen entry BandSize; signed gain measured from original entry, not from exit; first observed trade at/beyond target
protocol.drawdown: Track minimum signed entry-relative profit and peak-to-trough drawdown from original exit through first target touch
limitations: Conditioned on original profitable watermark exits; not all entries
Hypothetical continuations can overlap later original trades; not portfolio P&L or a full strategy replay
No other profit exit after original watermark exit; descriptive room available until original stop or cutoff
Entire year has already informed strategy development; no untouched holdout claimed
Trade-price path only; no executable quotes; holiday cutoff uses last available trade
